text:
nina: incoming ticket from Northbridge Analytics — Invoice shows duplicates for Jan-2025 and one copy is missing embedding line items. Ticket #BILL-8002. Customer attached PDFs.
billing-bot: nightly_reconcile@2025-02-01 completed. Alerts: duplicate_invoice_group detected for customer_id=NB-210, period=2025-01.
carl: invoice ids?
nina: INV-2025-5102 and INV-2025-5102-2. Totals differ by $1.12. INV-2025-5102 (first-created) has subtotal that excludes embeddings.
sophie: quick log grab shows a race in invoice generation when the line_items write times out during high load. Looks like the generator retried and created a second invoice without the items attached. snippet: ```
2025-01-31T23:59:59Z ERROR invoice_writer: write_line_items timeout after 20s
2025-01-31T23:59:59Z INFO invoice_writer: retrying create (idempotency_key=null)
2025-01-31T23:59:59Z INFO invoice_writer: created invoice INV-2025-5102-2
```
carl: not ideal. can we do a safe remediation? customer is asking for a corrected invoice asap.
finance-lead: approve immediate remediation: void the duplicate (INV-2025-5102-2) and issue credit for the duplicated amount. authorize refund up to $15k. document action in ticket.
nina: running ad-hoc script: `./tools/finance/fix_duplicate.py --dup INV-2025-5102-2 --target INV-2025-5102 --reason "retry created duplicate; missing line items"`
nina: script output: "voided INV-2025-5102-2, created credit CR-3091 for $4,921.34, attached missing embedding lines to INV-2025-5102 and recalculated total." Updated ticket #BILL-8002.
sophie: code path fix: add fallback idempotency key when request_id is null using sha256(customer_id + billed_period) and make invoice + line_items write transactional with exponential backoff on transient DB errors. I'll open hotfix PR and include an integration test that simulates a line_items timeout.
carl: please also add an alert that surfaces invoices created within the same 5-minute window for same customer+period and a runbook entry for manual checks.
finance-lead: confirmed customer notified and refund processed. escalate to eng-runtime for hotfix. assign postmortem to billing infra.
nina: closing loop in ticket, adding postmortem request BILL-8002-PM and linking the PR. :white_check_mark:
